story_text:
## Meet SlashVibe
[画像: Meet SlashVibe]
## Why It Stands Out
[画像: Why It Stands Out]
## See how it works
[画像: See how it works]
Every agent. At a glance.
See all your AI agent sessions on one display. Switch sessions and bring any window to the front. Review and approve agent requests right on SlashVibe.
To-dos that do more.
To-dos are automatically captured as you speak. Tasks get done before you even ask. Add, update, or delegate tasks. Just by speaking.
Meetings, handled.
Flick through smart prompts to catch up, get answers, or ask better questions. Mute or record with a tap. No more searching for buttons. Turn meeting action items into to-dos and agent tasks automatically.
## A direct line from thought to task
[画像: A direct line from thought to task.]
Talking should be the fastest way to get work moving. SlashVibe's physical controls, close-range microphone, and voice software work together. Add a to-do, ask for help in a meeting, or speak your next prompt to the agent you've selected. No typing out long instructions. No hunting for a mic icon. Your words land where you need them, cleaned up and ready to send.
Ready in under 100 ms
Press the button, and SlashVibe is ready to record in under 100 milliseconds. No awkward pause before you speak, and no wondering if it’s listening yet. It’s a dedicated key, so it won’t clash with shortcuts in your other apps. Just get your thoughts out while they’re fresh.
Clean text, not a raw transcript.
SlashVibe comes with its own voice input software, so you don’t need a separate dictation app. It removes filler words, fixes formatting, and uses your own terms, so what lands on screen reads like you typed it. It can automatically add project names, libraries, and teammates’ names to your personal dictionary, so they’re spelled correctly every time.
Speak quietly. Send when you're ready.
Bring the mic close and speak softly, whether you’re in an open office or working late at night. When you’re done, press Send. Need to change something? Just edit it by voice. Changed your mind? Press Cancel, and nothing gets sent.
Anywhere you'd type.
It’s not just for agents. Use it for prompts, emails, notes, messages, and searches. SlashVibe adjusts the tone for each: precise for prompts, polished for emails, and natural for quick messages. One voice tool for your whole workday.
Multilingual voice input.
Speak in the language you think in. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more are supported. Accuracy varies by language.
## A clear view. A clearer head
[画像: A clear view. A clearer head.]
Let your agents work in parallel while you stay focused on what’s in front of you. SlashVibe keeps their progress in view on its own display, right beside your main screen, so a glance tells you what’s running, what’s done, and what needs you.
No need to open every conversation just to check. No mental list of things to come back to. Your main screen stays free for your work, with less to keep track of and fewer reasons to lose your train of thought.
Your to-dos, with the AI work behind them.
Each to-do can have one or more related AI tasks organized beneath it. "Prepare a client proposal" might include tasks to gather reference material and draft the proposal. When you check your list, you can see how that work is going, what's ready to review, and what still needs you.
Live notes, right beside the call.
Follow the discussion through live notes and scroll back when you miss something. Flick through prompts like "Catch me up" or "What should I ask," and the answers show up on SlashVibe, so you stay in the conversation.
Hear it when an agent needs you.
When an agent stops and waits for your input, SlashVibe updates its status on the display and plays a short alert. No more finding out an hour later that it’s been waiting on you. Of course, you can turn off the sound whenever you need to focus without interruptions.
Back from a break? Read the brief.
Work Brief summarizes what’s done, what’s still running, and what’s next across your agents. Catch up at a glance, then open the task you want to continue.
## Your next idea. In gadget form
[画像: Your next idea. In gadget form.]
Make SlashVibe your own.
Connect an agent we haven't added yet, or design a dashboard around the way you work. You can also create your own tools for the work you do most. You could even build a tiny garden that grows as your agents finish tasks.
Whatever you build, it becomes part of the device you use every day.
Bring your own agents.
Using a tool that’s not on our list yet? Connect it, then use SlashVibe’s display and controls to interact with it.
Put what matters on screen.
Track API spend against your budget, count down to a deadline, or keep a do-not-disturb timer running while you focus. If it’s worth seeing at a glance, just put it on SlashVibe.
Or just make it fun.A pixel pet that perks up as tasks get done. A mini game for when your agent is still thinking. We can’t wait to see what you build.
I’m still not sure why one of our engineers decided to play Pokémon on SlashVibe, but he did.
## It just feels right
[画像: It just feels right.]
Handheld
Lean back. Stay in control.
Your work still needs your attention. It just doesn't need your hands on the keyboard. With AI agents taking on more of the work and voice input to guide them, you can finally put that expensive ergonomic chair to good use. Detach the controller, lean back, and keep your agents moving.
Quiet voice
Bring it closer to pick up even a whisper.
Talking to your computer in an open office can feel awkward. Bring the controller close and speak softly. It still hears you clearly, and nobody else needs to.
Desktop
Rotate it. The joystick falls right under your thumb.
When you're heads-down at your desk, SlashVibe sits right beside your keyboard.
Turn the controller so the joystick lands under your thumb, then switch sessions, record and send without hunting for the right window.
## Works with your stack
[画像: Works with your stack.]
## Why a dedicated controller?
[画像: Why a dedicated controller?]
## Crafted to impress
[画像: Crafted to impress.]
Made to earn its place on your desk.
Sandblasted, anodized aluminium
Display housing, base and action keycaps.
Ultra-low-profile switches
Kailh ultra-low-profile mechanical switches with short, decisive travel.
Soft-touch controller
Soft-touch upper surfaces and joystick cap.
Two finishes
Black or Silver. Choose your color after the campaign via survey.

## A letter from Loda
[画像: A letter from Loda]
Hi, I'm Loda, co-founder of SlashVibe.
It's hard to describe how excited I am to finally press the launch button today.
It's been almost a year since I left my previous company to start building SlashVibe.
Back then, I was making ergonomic keyboards. I loved the idea that something we designed could improve how people sit and work every day. But at the same time, I noticed something changing in my own workflow.
I was typing less and less.
I started using voice input more often, and AI was taking over more of my daily work. Even writing an email often meant speaking my thoughts and letting AI polish them.
That made me wonder: Instead of making typing more comfortable, what if we could help people type less altogether?
That question eventually became SlashVibe.
Over the past year, our product has changed a lot. AI moves incredibly fast, and we've had to rethink many things along the way.
But a few beliefs have stayed the same. AI agents will become a bigger part of our work. People will always want more natural and comfortable ways to interact with technology. And we'll still spend meaningful time at our desks, focusing on the things that matter most.
I believe a small, always-on workspace with intuitive, tactile controls can make that experience so much better.
I've been using SlashVibe on my own desk for the past two months, and I've realized just how big the gap is between something that works and something you genuinely love using.
Today, it's surprisingly easy to vibe code a prototype that monitors AI agents, records your voice, or triggers shortcuts. But building a reliable, refined tool that you actually want to use every day is a completely different challenge.
That's what we've been working toward.
It's also why we've delayed our launch so many times. We first tested our crowdfunding concept back in April, then planned for June, August, October, and finally November.
Every delay was frustrating, but every improvement made me more convinced that it was worth it. We're not building something perfect on day one, but we're building something we believe in, and something we'll keep improving for years.
I still remember how excited I was when the name SlashVibe first came to mind.
"Slash" felt sharp, direct, and decisive. "Vibe" was about how something feels. Natural, effortless, and enjoyable.
As AI takes over more of the actual work, I've been thinking a lot about one question:
What will working feel like when AI does more of the work for us?
I hope it feels like SlashVibe.
Thank you so much for taking the time to read our story. It means a lot to me that you're here, and I truly hope you'll join us on this journey.
If you have any questions or ideas, feel free to leave a comment or email me directly at loda@slashvibe.ai. I'd love to hear from you.
Loda
Co-founder, SlashVibe
## Connect with SlashVibe
[画像: Connect with SlashVibe.]
This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 3,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1B raised between them.
risks: Building hardware is hard, and delays happen. Here's an honest look at where we are and what could slow us down. Production SlashVibe is made in Dongguan, China. Our co-founder manages the supply chain himself and works with the factory directly. Our team has shipped hardware to customers in the US, Korea and Japan before. We expect the first batch to start shipping in March 2027. What could cause delays Certification: SlashVibe has a battery and a wireless controller, so it has to pass FCC testing before it can ship. If something fails, we fix it and test again. We've left extra time in the schedule for this. Parts: If a key component runs short, production slows down. We're ordering key parts early and lining up backup suppliers where we can. Software: AI tools and meeting apps change fast, and support for some of them may change before we ship. We'll keep updating the SlashVibe software after delivery. Shipping: Delivery times and import rules vary by country, so some backers will get their SlashVibe sooner than others. Staying in touch We'll post regular updates with photos from the factory. If a date changes, we'll tell you why and give you the new date. You can always reach us at hello@slashvibe.ai or on Discord.

faq.q: What does SlashVibe do, and why use it instead of my phone or laptop?
faq.a:
SlashVibe is an AI workspace with its own display and physical controls, right beside your computer. A separate screen keeps the task, meeting, or agent session you’re following in view, so you can check it at a glance without covering your work.

A button press starts voice input, while the joystick and buttons let you move between sessions and respond to agent requests. These actions are quick, tactile, and within reach, with less searching through menus or switching windows. The USB-C connect…

faq.q: Do I need to run multiple AI agents to benefit from SlashVibe?
faq.a: No. With a single supported agent session, you can still see its status, use voice input, and access physical controls. When the agent needs input, you can respond by voice or bring its window to the front on your computer. You can also use SlashVibe for to-dos and meeting assistance. If you want to customize it, the developer SDK lets you build your own dashboards, tools, and agent integrations.

faq.q: Does SlashVibe need a computer, and can I use the controller wirelessly away from my desk?
faq.a:
Yes, the display needs a connection to your computer. The controller can be used wirelessly around your workspace.

The display unit connects to your computer via USB-C for power and data. A wired connection helps keep voice input latency low, provides continuous power, and keeps the connection reliable throughout the day.

The detachable controller connects wirelessly to the display over 2.4 GHz, so you can still lean back or move around your workspace with it. The display stays connected to yo…

faq.q: Which AI agents and apps does SlashVibe work with?
faq.a:
SlashVibe works with more than 20 AI agents and tools, including Claude Code CLI and Desktop, Claude Cowork, Codex CLI and Desktop, Copilot CLI, OpenCode v2 CLI, Pi Agent, Oh My Pi, Grok Build CLI, Cursor, Antigravity CLI, Hermes, DSH, Droid, Trae, Kiro, WorkBuddy, MiMo Code, ZCode, Gemini CLI, Qoder, Qwen, Kimi, and Kimi Code.

For meetings and calendars, it works with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, plus Google Calendar and Outlook.

We're continuing to expand support and are building…

faq.q: Do I need to switch to a new AI app or model to use SlashVibe?
faq.a: No. For supported agent workflows, you can keep using your existing AI tools, models, terminal, and IDE. SlashVibe adds a separate display, voice input, and physical controls to that workflow.

faq.q: Can I switch between different AI tools and multiple sessions of the same agent?
faq.a:
Yes. Multiple sessions from the same agent or different supported agents appear as separate tasks on SlashVibe’s display. You can check their status and use the physical controls to switch between them.

When a session finishes or needs input, you can review its status, respond by voice, or bring its window to the front on your computer.

faq.q: Do I need to subscribe to another voice-input app?
faq.a: No. SlashVibe includes voice input, so you don’t need to subscribe to a separate dictation app.

faq.q: Which languages does voice input support?
faq.a: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more. Accuracy varies by language.

faq.q: Is a paid SlashVibe subscription required?
faq.a:
No. SlashVibe includes a free plan, with optional paid plans for more AI credits and cloud sync. AI features like meeting assistance, voice, and to-do hand-offs can run on your plan’s credits or on your own API key.

All Kickstarter backers will receive one complimentary month of the Pro plan.

faq.q: Can I use my existing AI accounts and subscriptions, and are any AI subscriptions included with SlashVibe?
faq.a: Yes. You can keep using your own accounts and subscriptions for supported AI tools, such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. When you delegate a task to an agent, execution uses your own agent account. Third-party AI subscriptions and API credits are not included with SlashVibe. Its AI-powered meeting assistance, notes, and to-do features can run on your plan's credits or your own API key. Any AI subscription or API usage charges are paid to the relevant provider.

faq.q: What can I build with the SlashVibe SDK?
faq.a:
You can create your own dashboards, tools, and AI agent integrations. For example, you could keep the progress of your own workflow on the display, build a control panel for a task you repeat often, or connect an agent we haven’t added yet.

Your custom software runs on your computer, with its interface streamed to SlashVibe. That gives you access to your computer’s processing power and room for a wide range of tools and interactive experiences, with performance depending mainly on your computer…

faq.q: Can I build something with the SDK without hardware development experience?
faq.a:
Yes. You can build your own tools using Node.js or Python without designing circuits or working with device firmware. You work on what SlashVibe displays and how it responds to your actions.

Vibe coding can help you turn an idea into a working tool: describe what you want to an AI coding agent, try what it builds, and refine it together. You can even use SlashVibe to manage the agent building your custom SlashVibe tools. It’s a fun way to use the device while making it your own.

faq.q: Which parts of SlashVibe can I customize with the SDK?
faq.a:
The SDK supports custom screen layouts, button and joystick events, and text transcribed from voice input. These capabilities are included in the initial SDK release. You can decide what appears on the screen, how your tool responds to the controls, and how it uses spoken input.

Integrations with other apps depend on the interfaces and permissions those apps provide. The SDK does not automatically give you control over every feature of every app.

faq.q: When do you expect SlashVibe to ship?
faq.a: We currently expect the first batch to begin shipping in March 2027.
Join the SlashVibe Discord community for product updates and conversation, or email us at hello@slashvibe.ai. We typically reply within 48 hours.
